llc.formation_notes: $85 online, $90 paper (form rev. 2/27/26). Older third-party figures of $160/$165 are outdated.

annual_report.name: Information Report (biennial since Jan 1, 2024)
annual_report.due: April 15 (for-profit) of every even year if formed in an even year, every odd year if formed in an odd year
annual_report.late_penalty: three-month delinquency period after the due date, then forfeiture; reinstatement required

sources.quote: All for profit businesses are due by April 15th of their respective odd or even year

sources.title: Kansas SOS - Biennial Business Filing
sources.quote: Starting January 1, 2024, Kansas businesses will file information reports with the Kansas Secretary of State every two years

pte_elective_tax.rate_note: SALT Parity Act (L. 2022): electing pass-through entities pay tax at the highest individual rate under K.S.A. 79-32,110(a) (5.58% for 2024 onward unless reduced); owners get a credit.

sources.title: K.S.A. 79-32,287 Tax rate imposed (electing pass-through entity)
sources.quote: an electing pass-through entity shall be subject to a tax in an amount equal to the highest rate of tax for the applicable income tax year under K.S.A. 79-32,110(a)

personal_exemption.notes: Deduction; plus $2,320 per dependent (incl. unborn child). Head of household standard deduction $6,180.

income_tax_2026.surtaxes: None. K.S.A. 79-32,110c can cut rates automatically from the next tax year when revenue and rainy-day fund triggers are met (first determination Aug 15, 2025).

sources.title: K.S.A. 79-32,110 Individual tax rates
sources.quote: For tax year 2024, and all tax years thereafter: ... Not over $23,000 5.2% of Kansas taxable income Over $23,000 $1,196 plus 5.58% of excess over $23,000

sources.title: K.S.A. 79-32,119 Standard deduction
sources.quote: For tax year 2024, and all tax years thereafter ... Single individual filing status, $3,605; married filing status, $8,240

sources.title: K.S.A. 79-32,121 Kansas personal exemptions
sources.quote: married individuals filing a joint return, a personal exemption of $18,320 ... single ... $9,160

sources.title: K.S.A. 79-32,110c Adjustment of tax rates
sources.quote: Commencing on August 15, 2025, and every August 15 thereafter, the director of the budget ... shall determine whether the total fiscal year adjusted general revenue fund collections

estimated_tax.required_if: you can reasonably expect to owe at least $500 after withholding and credits, and withholding/credits are below 90% of current-year or 100% of prior-year tax
estimated_tax.notes: Due dates assumed to follow the federal schedule; not read on an official page (ksrevenue.gov unreachable)

notable: LLC formation fee is now $85 online (form revised Feb 2026) and the information report is biennial at $90 online (https://sos.ks.gov/forms/business_services/DL.pdf)

Two brackets only: 5.2% and 5.58% above $23,000 single / $46,000 joint (https://www.kslegislature.gov/li/b2025_26/statute/079_000_0000_chapter/079_032_0000_article/079_032_0110_section/079_032_0110_k/)
Estimated tax only if you expect to owe $500 or more (https://www.kslegislature.gov/li/b2025_26/statute/079_000_0000_chapter/079_032_0000_article/079_032_0101_section/079_032_0101_k/)
